protocol_change_from_v4: Three prespecified rounds compare fresh current v4 (including the audit-only plan-length fix) with v5 completion-aware resume evidence. Facts, tools, model, read points and per-trial wire admission budgets are shared. New independent public-receipt metrics distinguish informed post-completion calls from calls preplanned in one response. No metric, declaration or completion check gates tools. Historical results are not concurrent observations. The 36-trial scope has 200k tokens per round and 600k across all three prespecified rounds.
